lines.beaver_en: Good work. How were your results this time?
lines.learner: 오늘 경기에서 동메달을 땄습니다. 나쁘지 않아요.
lines.en: I won a bronze medal in today's competition. Not bad.
lines.roman: oneul gyeonggieseo dongmedareul ttatseumnida. nappeuji anayo.

lines.beaver_en: How was the final? Neck and neck, right?
lines.en: Yes, it was neck and neck. I fell behind in shooting.

lines.beaver_en: The crowd was loud. Were you nervous?
lines.learner: 네, 함성에 신경이 쓰여서 과녁을 놓쳤어요.
lines.en: Yes, the cheering bothered me and I missed the target.
lines.roman: ne, hamseonge singyeongi sseuyeoseo gwanyeogeul nochyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What did you think of the player who won?
lines.en: True to having dominated last year's league, they were amazing.

lines.beaver_en: I see. How was the riding?
lines.learner: 승마 1위를 하는 등 여러 종목에 재능을 발휘했어요.
lines.en: I showed my talent in several events, like taking first in riding.
lines.roman: seungma irwireul haneun deung yeoreo jongmoge jaeneungeul balhwihaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How was swimming? Your time was good, right?
lines.learner: 네, 수영은 제 최고 기록이 나왔어요.
lines.en: Yes, I set my personal best in swimming.
lines.roman: ne, suyeongeun je choego girogi nawasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: You lost some points in fencing, right?
lines.en: Yes, I rushed at the end and lost points.

lines.beaver_en: Did you think of quitting in the last run?
lines.en: I didn't withdraw. I ran all the way to the finish line.

lines.learner: 승자는 못 됐지만 패자도 아니라고 생각해요.
lines.en: I wasn't the winner, but I don't think I'm a loser.
lines.roman: seungjaneun mot dwaetjiman paejado anirago saenggakaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good attitude. Get some good rest today.
lines.en: Thank you, coach. I'll win next time for sure.
